_what: Stage C of research/rvt_lookdev_design.md: the meadow boulders take the landscape's colour/roughness/normal in their bottom blend_cm, read from the runtime virtual textures. Built by scripts/make_rvt_blend_material.py: duplicates source_material (KiteDemo M_Photoscan_Master, Material Attributes output) into target_dir once, injects a BlendMaterialAttributes (A = original, B = RVT ground, Alpha = strength * saturate(1 - (WorldZ - RVT WorldHeight) / blend_cm), pixel attributes only) once, then child MIs of the copy carrying each source instance's values. RVT asset paths come from rvt_recipe (one declaration).
_blend_check: 2026-10-03: control at 500 cm turned the boulders fully meadow-coloured (rvt_C_control) -- RVT written and sampled. Boulders sit on the Grass layer, displacement 0.03 m, so the undisplaced RVT height is within 3 cm of the rendered ground: inside the 25 cm band.
